messages:
Nina: Quick sync on the Playground streaming UI — proposing a different affordance for interrupting generation.
Nina: Idea: replace \"Stop\" with \"Freeze\" (keeps partial text locked for review), and surface two actions: \"Try again\" and \"Continue generating\".
Omar: \"Freeze\" reads neat but might confuse non-technical users. Could we show an inline tooltip: \"Freeze = keep partial output\"? :question:
Becky: Token counter concern: if we Freeze we should show \"tokens so far\" vs \"final tokens\" once generation completes. Otherwise users think billing happened already.
Liam: Agree. Proposal for counter: small badge that says \"~45 tokens (in-progress)\" then on finalization switch to \"45 tokens\". Keep the in-progress badge aria-live polite.
Kai: Accessibility: when the stream is interrupted we need a clear live-region announcement. Suggested text: \"Generation paused. Partial response visible. Press Continue to resume or Try again to create a new response.\"
Nina: UX trade: showing both Try again and Continue could lead to accidental regen taps. What if Try again is under a kebab menu and Continue is primary?
Omar: I'd invert that: Try again primary because that's the action most users take after a bad response. We should A/B test which is less error-prone.
Becky: Prompt library integration idea: if user regenerates, save the exact prompt+settings as a historic variant in the prompt library with a small tag \"regenerated\" so users can inspect iterations. Could help debugging prompts.
Liam: Love that. UX note: the prompt library row should show delta in tokens and a quick diff icon.
Kai: Keyboard shortcuts: propose \"f\" for Freeze, \"c\" for Continue, \"t\" for Try again. Documented in the keyboard help panel and shown on hover. Also ensure no conflict with browser defaults.
Nina: Microcopy candidates: \"Freeze output\" / \"Continue generation\" / \"Try again\" vs \"Pause\" / \"Resume\" / \"Regenerate\". Which reads clearest? Thoughts?
Omar: My vote: Pause/Resume/Regenerate is familiar from other apps, lower cognitive load. But Freeze maps better to locked partial content. Maybe run a small preference poll.
Becky: Billing ops: flagging billing team — pseudobilling: are in-progress tokens provisional? We should not finalize billing until the stream completes or user confirms. Jordan from billing will need to weigh in.
Liam: Implementation note for runtime: Continue should reuse the same stream session (retain KV cache). Try again should start a new session and optionally reset chat-level cache. I'll add a PR link later.
design-bot: Updated mockups with both label sets and token badge states -> https://figma.com/file/stream-labels (frames attached). Accessibility notes added.
design-bot: @channel Frames: freeze-flow-v1, pause-flow-v1, token-badge-states.
Nina: A/B plan: run two cohorts: Label set A (Freeze/Try again/Continue) vs Label set B (Pause/Regenerate/Resume). Metrics: accidental regen rate, time-to-first-action, token confusion help tickets. Start with 2% traffic for 2 weeks.
Omar: Add instrumentation: event for \"partial_viewed\", \"continue_clicked\", \"tryagain_clicked\", and include token counts at each event.
Becky: I'll draft the prompt-library tagging spec and token-badge copy.
Liam: I'll coordinate with runtime on session semantics and add the KV-cache kill switch for Try again.
Kai: I'll produce the aria copy and keyboard shortcut doc and run it by accessibility.
Nina: Great. I'll assemble the rollout doc and schedule a 30m sync next Tues. Thanks everyone! :sparkles:
